title.en: 《中华思想脉络》 on the spine, and the theory in classical names
title.zh: 《中华思想脉络》在脊柱上，与以古典之名所写的理论

statement.en: Every one of the 5,673 judgments of 《中华思想脉络》 v1.0 is read against the spine: 3,514 bear on its structures, each placed once in its flagged cluster, in 1,300 checked entries (453 agreements, 647 exact scopes, 200 divergences). 449 classical names, one per concept, state the theory in the 中华本《变化论》.
statement.zh: 《中华思想脉络》v1.0 的 5,673 条判断逐条对照脊柱：3,514 条关乎其结构，各在所标之簇恰落一处，成 1,300 个已检查条目（相合 453、定域 647、相分 200）；449 个古典之名，每概念一个，写成中华本《变化论》。

hypotheses.en: No Lean and no premise is added: each entry is tied to audited declarations and records as they stand; its kind, its reading and the names are the AI's (D62). A passage counts as relational when it reads the relation first and lets the terms differentiate within it, not from a prior ground, a nature or value fixed before relations, a will or single centre, or a contest or rank: a method requirement, not a proof of the ontology. The names are a code formed among the theory's users, constrained by the attested senses, not a sense recovered from history.
hypotheses.zh: 不新增 Lean，不加前提：每个条目对应到现有的已审计声明与记录，其关系类别、读法与名都是 AI 的（D62）。“关系的”以方法的要求检验：先读关系，让诸项在其中分化；其反面是先在的根据、先于关系而定的性或价值、意志或单一中心、争胜与等级。这是方法的要求，不是本体论的证明。名是理论的用者之间形成的码，受所见之义约束，不是从历史中复原的意义。

does_not_show.en: That any passage is true as stated, or that its authors meant these laws; agreement means the spine has a law of that structure, often under conditions the reading names.
does_not_show.zh: 任何一段如所说那样为真，或其作者意谓这些律；相合是说脊柱上有结构相同之律，常在读法写明的条件下。

does_not_show.en: That the language or the tradition is relational by nature: the relational start is a dominant thread strongest at the earliest layer, not a property of every system; the distribution by era is of this corpus, whose later texts were chosen for their debates on ground and nature.
does_not_show.zh: 语言或传统天然是关系的：关系的起点是一条在最早一层最强的主导线索，不是每一体系的性质；按时代的分布是这一语料的，其后世文本多为本原与心性之争而选。

does_not_show.en: That the classical names recover what the texts meant, or that names without a recorded witness were in pre-Qin use: 95 classical words in the table carry no checked quotation.
does_not_show.zh: 古典之名复原了文本之意，或未录出处之名在先秦已有用例：名表中 95 个古名与复名没有经核对的引文。

does_not_show.en: That a divergence of standing (a text asserting what the theory gives only under the continuation condition) shows the text wrong; the theory asserts no ethical axiom.
does_not_show.zh: 地位的相分（原文断言理论只在延续条件之下给出者）说明原文错了；理论不断言伦理公理。

does_not_show.en: That a judgment flagged for one cluster lies in no other: 96 are placed in other clusters too; 5 of them are taken in one and rejected in another, each rejection naming the cluster that takes it, which verify_zh.py checks; 31 have another kind in another cluster, which is not checked.
does_not_show.zh: 所标之判断不落于他簇：96 条另落他簇；其中 5 条在一簇取而在他簇不取，其不取皆注明所归之簇，由 verify_zh.py 检查；31 条他簇之类与所标之簇不同，未经检查。

validation_scope.en: verify_zh.py passes (RAE to RAE3, 4–5 November 2026; in research-test since): 438 files bound, a verdict per judgment (5,673), the 3,514 flagged each placed once in its flagged cluster and rejected elsewhere only as taken there, 2,023 fragments verbatim, 1,603 declarations in receipt 20261103T211917.845905Z, 234 records, 449 names, and 06's 114 Lean-name citations, each exact (one more off the spine), record links and 12 numbers of §七; the chapters' own checks ran until they went to history/ (23 October 2026). All readers AI; no edition collated.
validation_scope.zh: verify_zh.py 通过（RAE 至 RAE3，11 月 4、5 日；此后随 research-test）：导入 438 文件，5,673 条判断各一裁定，所标 3,514 条各在所标之簇落一处、他簇不取必注所归，2,023 片段逐字，1,603 声明在回执 20261103T211917.845905Z 中，234 份记录，449 名，06 之 114 处 Lean 名（各确指一名，另一在脊柱外）、记录链接与第七节十二数；诸章之核止于 10 月 23 日入 history/。读者皆 AI；未与刻本对校。

next_delta.en: The gaps the texts raise, each to be claimed before it is written: witnesses that are functions of one another; measures of a juncture; a pool weighted by share. Then the three RO and 易传 kinds decided in the chapter written into those maps.
next_delta.zh: 古典文字提出的缺口，各先认领再写：互为函数的见证；机之度量；按份额加权的池。然后把本章判定的 RO 与易传三处类别写入那两份对应。

correspondence.en: Ren, 19 October 2026, after extending his database to Chinese culture: “请把中华文化中所有在theory of becoming上有映射，或者对应的，找出来，并寻找到非同于英文系统的一套符号系统，这个系统存在于古中文之中，在历史长河中一直在演变和迭代……现在不用改英文版本，我们只是做中华版本，用中华的体系和符号系统 - 它自然就是一元的，关系的，动态的……同时，请把我做的这个脉络，也整合进我们的theories” (provenance, not warrant). The chapter places the 脉络 in the theory and tests the thesis judgment by judgment; the 中华本 states the theory in the classical names, with 經, 說 and 證 for each law and the classical passages set beside it. Reading (the AI's, D62): the thesis holds at the root and in most mapped judgments, needs a scope in its universal forms, and fails as a property of every system.
correspondence.zh: Ren，2026年10月19日，把数据库扩展到中华文化之后说：“请把中华文化中所有在theory of becoming上有映射，或者对应的，找出来，并寻找到非同于英文系统的一套符号系统，这个系统存在于古中文之中，在历史长河中一直在演变和迭代……现在不用改英文版本，我们只是做中华版本，用中华的体系和符号系统 - 它自然就是一元的，关系的，动态的……同时，请把我做的这个脉络，也整合进我们的theories”（来历，不是根据）。本章把脉络安放在理论中，并逐条检验论题；中华本以古典之名陈述理论，每条律有经、说、证，并列出相对照的古典文字。读法（AI 的，D62）：论题在根上与大多数已对应的判断中成立，其全称形式需要定域，作为每一体系的性质不成立。

history.en: 22 October 2026, WH1 and SAT1: the first two gaps, a conjunctive or graded whole and saturation of a coupling, are stated (records a-whole-of-every-part, a-coupling-saturated-by-what-it-has-carried; study sections 333 and 334); the five entries naming them read the new laws and their gap notes point to them. history.en: 22 October 2026, ZG1-ZG3: 25 entries' gaps are stated (sixteen records; study sections 338-340), their readings revised and gap notes pointing to the laws; one-sided and local regulation, equal division and copying growth leave the gap list. The map's kinds and counts are unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月22日，ZG1-ZG3：25 个条目之缺口已陈述（十六项记录；研究第 338-340 节），其读法修订，gap 注指向新律；单侧与局部的调节、均分、抄录之增离开缺口之列。对应之类别与计数不变。

history.en: 22 October 2026, ZG4-ZG6: 21 entries' gaps are stated (twelve records; study sections 341-343), their readings revised and gap notes pointing to the laws; 13 gap notes that ask for no law are marked as scope remarks, their text kept. The map's kinds and counts are unchanged; three entries whose kind rested on a gap now proved say so.
history.zh: 2026年10月22日，ZG4-ZG6：21 个条目之缺口已陈述（十二项记录；研究第 341-343 节），其读法修订，gap 注指向新律；13 条不求律之 gap 注标为范围之注，原文保留。对应之类别与计数不变；三个以缺定类之条目注明其缺已补。

history.en: 22 October 2026, ZG7: the last open gap notes. Nine entries are stated (seven records; study section 344), 老子七十九章 answered by laws on the spine with its signed form out of scope, 孟子「亲亲而仁民」 marked a scope remark, and 唯识「無因」 left open as the chapter's open problem with its reason. The map's kinds and counts are unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月22日，ZG7：最后仍开之 gap 注。九个条目之缺口已陈述（七项记录；研究第 344 节），老子七十九章由脊柱现有之律补，其有符号之形为范围；孟子「亲亲而仁民」标为范围之注；唯识「無因」作为主章之开放问题仍开，注明其故。对应之类别与计数不变。

history.en: 22 October 2026, ZG8: the last open gap note, 唯识「無因」, reads the law of forming, necessary and sufficient (record forming-anew-necessary-and-sufficient; study section 345); no gap note of the map is open.

history.en: 22 October 2026 (WL, study section 346, D63): the name table's seventh pass adds 文 and 文同 (449 names) and revises others against 文理生生's sources; the 中华本 gains 一·二十一; the map entry xici-ji-qi-shu reads 「极其数」 as the yarrow count only, with the bound laws as a contrast, as xici-can-wu-cuo-zong and 一·二十一 do; see wenli-on-the-spine.
history.zh: 2026年10月22日（WL，研究第 346 节，D63）：名表第七次之改立文与文同（449 个名），并据文理生生之出处修订他名；中华本增一·二十一；对应表条目 xici-ji-qi-shu 读「极其数」只为揲蓍之数，有界之律只作对照，与 xici-can-wu-cuo-zong 及一·二十一同；见 wenli-on-the-spine。

history.en: 4 November 2026, board item RAE (AA Phase 0's E3, E1, E2): verify_zh.py had pointed at the three chapters RA moved to history/ (23 October) and skipped them without a word, ran in no test, and rewrote a tracked file on every run; the map named a record CD renamed (whole-first-and-bounded-centers, now whole-and-regions-and-bounded-centers, 27 citations) and a declaration ND renamed in OU7 (Pool.difference_belongs_to_the_joint, now Pool.difference_only_together, 7 declaration lists and 11 mentions in readings, notes and a proposal). passages.json renamed by a dated script (zhonghua/rename_2026-11-04.py), each entry changed noted; the verifier now checks 06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS's Lean names, record links and nine numbers its §七 states of the map and the name table, fails on a missing chapter or one where it finds no Lean name, writes no file, and runs with research-test; the validation scope is restated from the passing run's own summary, and, to keep within the length rule, no longer says that "each entry had three readings (mapper, reviser, independent checker); the 中华本 was reviewed as one book three times", true of that work as before. Claims, kinds, readings' words and the law unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年11月4日，看板项 RAE（AA 第零阶段之 E3、E1、E2）：verify_zh.py 原指向 RA 于 10 月 23 日移入 history/ 之三章，缺之则默然跳过，不在任何测试中，且每次运行改写一个受版本管理之文件；对应表引一份 CD 已更名之记录（whole-first-and-bounded-centers，今为 whole-and-regions-and-bounded-centers，27 处）与一个 ND 于 OU7 更名之声明（Pool.difference_belongs_to_the_joint，今为 Pool.difference_only_together，7 个声明表及读法、注与一提议中 11 处）。passages.json 以一份注明日期之脚本更名（zhonghua/rename_2026-11-04.py），每个改动之条目皆有注；检查脚本今核 06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS 之 Lean 名、记录链接及其第七节所述对应表与名表之九数，缺章或章中不见 Lean 名即不通过，不写文件，并随 research-test 运行；验证范围依通过之运行自身之摘要重写，并为合长度之规，不再写“每个条目经三读（映射者、以现行主干重读的修订者、独立检查者）；中华本各篇起草后经对抗审读改为精确修改”，其于该工作仍真。断言、类别、读法之文与律未变。

history.en: 4 November 2026 (AA, erratum E4): 'each placed once' is scoped to the cluster each judgment was flagged for, which is what verify_zh.py checks; a recount of coverage.json and passages.json finds 96 of the 3,499 placed in other clusters too (3,600 placements), 6 of them kept in one cluster and rejected in another, now a does-not-show item. No count, kind or entry changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月4日（AA，勘误 E4）：“各落一处”限于各判断所标之簇，即 verify_zh.py 所查；据 coverage.json 与 passages.json 重数，3,499 条中 96 条另落他簇（共 3,600 处），其中 6 条在一簇取而在他簇不取，今列入不能说明之项。计数、类别与条目均未改。

history.en: 5 November 2026, board item RAE2: verify_zh.py had read 06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS's unprefixed Lean names as the end of any audited declaration, so a name ending some declaration passed and an ambiguous one was not refused; each now resolves to exactly one, whole, with Becoming. before it, or in the namespace 06 states for its section or table; §五 states Becoming.Hexagram for the configurations' names and writes the other laws' namespaces, and three names that resolved to no declaration as written are written in full in 06. The scope's count (114 citations, and one module named off the spine, checked as a file) is the passing run's. Claims unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年11月5日，看板项 RAE2：verify_zh.py 原把 06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS 未带前缀之 Lean 名读作任一已审声明之末段，故凡为某声明末段之名皆通过，有歧义者亦不拒；今每名须恰确指一名：如所写、前加 Becoming.、或加 06 于其节或其表所述之命名空间；第五节说明卦之名在 Becoming.Hexagram 中，其余之律写出命名空间；06 中三名照所写不指任何声明，改写全名。验证范围之数（114 处，另一模块为脊柱外者，只核其文件）为通过之运行所给。断言未变。

history.en: 5 November 2026, board item RAE3 (AA Phase 0's E4; ED3's classical reader's E3C-04, -06, -10): of the 6 judgments kept in one cluster and rejected in another, 5 are rejected where the rejection names the cluster that takes them (LE-R020 and LE-R021 in C02, WP-XCS-C01-S01-R04 in C08, LL-R015 in C11, RU1-LY-18-10-R02 in C13), and verify_zh.py now checks that every such rejection does; the sixth, TP-H22-X4-R01, which C17's reviser had asked to be moved out of C07's rejections, is a parallel of xiaoxiang-weidang in C07 too (zhonghua/resolve_2026-11-05.py). Fifteen judgments the sweep had left unflagged were placed in the map (seven entries rest on them alone); each is flagged for the cluster that places it (zhonghua/flag_2026-11-05.py), so 3,514 bear on the structures, not 3,499, and verify_zh.py refuses an unflagged judgment in the map. Read across clusters by one rule (build_tables.placements: a judgment's kind where a cluster takes it, its own first; not taken only where none does), 245 are taken nowhere, so 06 §七's mapped count is 3,269; its shares are unchanged. make_record.py and catalogue_entries.py write the current wording and refuse to overwrite. The scope now lists the chapters' checks to 23 October only as having run (the RAE notes above list them). The entries, their count and their kinds are unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年11月5日，看板项 RAE3（AA 第零阶段之 E4；ED3 古典读者之 E3C-04、-06、-10）：一簇取而他簇不取之 6 条中，5 条之不取皆注明取之之簇（LE-R020、LE-R021 于 C02，WP-XCS-C01-S01-R04 于 C08，LL-R015 于 C11，RU1-LY-18-10-R02 于 C13），verify_zh.py 今查每一此类不取皆如此；第六条 TP-H22-X4-R01，C17 之修订者已请移出 C07 之不取，今于 C07 亦为 xiaoxiang-weidang 之并列（zhonghua/resolve_2026-11-05.py）。分拣未标之 15 条已入对应（七个条目只依之），今各标为所落之簇（zhonghua/flag_2026-11-05.py），故关乎结构者 3,514 条，非 3,499，verify_zh.py 拒对应中未标之判断。以一规则跨簇而读（build_tables.placements：判断之类取自取之之簇，先所标之簇；无簇取之方为不取），各簇皆不取者 245 条，故 06 第七节之已对应数为 3,269；其比例不变。make_record.py 与 catalogue_entries.py 今写现行之语，且不覆写。验证范围于诸章之核只言其止于 10 月 23 日（所核之项见上 RAE 之注）。条目、其数与其类均未改。
